{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Lucthz''''' was a group of 4 [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]]s used by the [[Nami]]. They were attempting to destroy [[Modular conveyor]] [[Ulzepdi]] which was fleeing from an [[Battle of Yrrna|attack]] on the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] cargo area in the [[Yrrna system/Legends|Yrrna system]] which was orchestrated by [[Ali Tarrak]] to demonstrate the power of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] that she [[Ambush on Hashim|managed]] to [[Battle of Kiilimaar|acquire]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. The Transports were destroyed by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] who was sent to investigate the situation in a [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Advanced]] starfighter.
